record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, factor item embeddings into a shared 64-dimensional table and separate learned input/output projections to 128 dimensions. Use two residual GRU blocks. Replace final-state-only readout with a learned gate combining the final real state and attention-pooled observed-prefix states, adding a learned nonnegative recency penalty to attention logits. Training pooling must be causal at every supervised position. Set maxlen=64, dropout=0.2, Adam LR=0.0005 and weight_decay=0.00001. Compact embeddings regularize the deeper recurrence while pooling preserves useful earlier interests. Preserve sampling and BPR.

category_rationales.rationale: Use stacked residual GRU blocks in one jointly trained recurrent model. Residual paths and layer normalization support the deeper recurrence while preserving causal next-item training.
Couple two 128-dimensional residual blocks with dropout 0.2, a shorter 64-item window, Adam learning rate 0.0005 and weight decay 0.00001. Keep seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap.

Factor item representations into one shared 64-dimensional table and separate learned input/output projections to the recurrent width. Training and candidate scoring use the same output projection; the generated predictor imports the changed class and restores its saved configuration.

Gate each recurrent state with attention over its observed prefix, using a learned nonnegative recency penalty. Pooling excludes padding and future positions at every supervised step. Inference selects the final real position, and empty histories produce a zero representation.
